SELECT p.id, p.name, p.category_id, (
    SELECT p4.image_url
    FROM product_images AS p4
    WHERE p4.product_id = p.id AND NOT (p4.is_deleted)
    ORDER BY p4.is_primary DESC, p4.sort_order, p4.id
    LIMIT 1), t."MinPrice", t."MaxPrice", t."InStock", p.min_order_qty, p.created_at
FROM products AS p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p0.product_id AS "Id", min(p1.base_price + p0.price_adjustment) AS "MinPrice", max(p1.base_price + p0.price_adjustment) AS "MaxPrice", EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM product_variants AS p2
        INNER JOIN products AS p3 ON p2.product_id = p3.id
        WHERE p3.shop_id = @__input_ShopId_0 AND NOT (p2.is_deleted) AND NOT (p3.is_deleted) AND (p3.status = 'Active'::product_status OR p3.status = 'OutOfStock'::product_status) AND p3.base_price + p2.price_adjustment >= 0.0 AND p0.product_id = p2.product_id AND p2.stock_qty > 0 AND p3.status = 'Active'::product_status) AS "InStock"
    FROM product_variants AS p0
    INNER JOIN products AS p1 ON p0.product_id = p1.id
    WHERE p1.shop_id = @__input_ShopId_0 AND NOT (p0.is_deleted) AND NOT (p1.is_deleted) AND p1.status IN ('Active'::product_status, 'OutOfStock'::product_status) AND p1.base_price + p0.price_adjustment >= 0.0
    GROUP BY p0.product_id
) AS t ON p.id = t."Id"
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id
LIMIT @__p_1
